cdc_synchronizers.name: xser_event
cdc_synchronizers.why: stream->serial config event: Gray h_seq, x1/x2/x3 serial synchroniser, ct/ca/cd/cv/dv/lv load h_* only when x2 != x3 (h_* stable >= 2 serial periods); 250 ps keeps the launch latency fixed on the compiler's issue phases

cdc_synchronizers.name: stream_reset
cdc_synchronizers.why: serial core reset rc[1] re-timed by two clk_in flops into the stream-domain reset

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin: every input lands in an unconditional pin flop (data) or a reset pin flop (valid/strobe/status), every output is a flop Q (HBMA-HOST 2026-10-17 audit of the source); a kit flop stage would add a redundant edge
